verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a fast path to a working payment flow: prebuilt Checkout pages (hosted or embedded) via the Checkout Sessions API, plus a sandbox and test cards for simulating successful and declined payments. A hands-on community report says the docs are "clear and concise" and the developer was accepting recurring payments in under an hour. Language-specific docs and sample code appear only for the machine-payments flow (a `?lang=node` doc variant, npm installs, a stripe-samples repo). missing for 10: explicit evidence of copy-paste code examples across multiple languages for the core Checkout/payment flow, and recent independent corroboration of the time-to-integrate (the hands-on report is old).
